title: Library extension
passage:
Can I renew this book online?
A. It is a newly published book.
B. Yes, unless another reader has reserved it.
C. The bookshelf is upstairs.
passageZh:
我可以在線上續借這本書嗎？
A. 這是新出版的書。
B. 可以，除非有其他讀者預約。
C. 書架在樓上。
